# v0.2.0 interop assets — Variant, ALP and deep nesting

Gathered for v0.2.0 acceptance. Assets are committed so the Variant/ALP and
generic nested-reader work can be tested without network access; no file here is
larger than 1 MB. Manifest with SHA-256 and provenance:
[`manifest.json`](manifest.json).

## Source and license

All fixtures in this directory are from
[apache/parquet-testing](https://github.com/apache/parquet-testing) at commit
`3acde70509f990c4ddfe34bf3ab05890657e766c` (2026-10-14):

- `shredded_variant/` — shredded-variant test cases (Apache-2.0). The cases were
  imported upstream from Apache Iceberg's `TestVariantReaders`.
- `data/alp_extended.zstd.parquet` — ALP FLOAT/DOUBLE fixture (Apache-2.0),
  generated by the Arrow C++ PR linked from the upstream README.
- Existing `official/` deep-nesting files are listed in the manifest; they are
  the same Apache-2.0 files from the v0.1.2 subset.

Upstream documents: [`shredded_variant/README.md`][sv-readme],
[`cases.json`][sv-cases], [`data/README.md#alp-encoding`][alp-note].
Refresh with:

```powershell
pwsh tool/interop/fetch_parquet_testing.ps1 -Verify
.agents/venv/Scripts/python.exe tool/interop/gen_v02_expected.py
```

## Variant selection

The Parquet files are tiny (864 B–3.4 KB). Eight cases were selected to cover
the unshredded form, the least-shredded primitive form and object shredding:

| Case | Size | Shredding | Semantic value (upstream `cases.json`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case-047` | 864 B | unshredded (metadata + value only) | `NULL` |
| `case-048` | 864 B | unshredded | `BOOLEAN true` |
| `case-049` | 865 B | unshredded | `BOOLEAN false` |
| `case-050` | 872 B | unshredded | `INT8 34` |
| `case-005` | 1152 B | least shredded: one top-level `typed_value` | `BOOLEAN false` |
| `case-006` | 1179 B | least shredded: one top-level `typed_value` | `INT8 34` |
| `case-130` | 2157 B | shallow shredded object (one level) | `{}` |
| `case-044` | 3370 B | nested shredded object (object in object) | `{c:{a:INT32 34,b:"iceberg"},d:DOUBLE -0.0}` |

`case-047`/`048` are the two smallest files in the whole upstream
`shredded_variant` set; `case-005` is the smallest file whose schema contains a
`typed_value` shredding column. The companion `*_row-0.variant.bin` files (4–49
bytes) hold the metadata+value payload for the row. `variant_cases.json` is the
upstream cases list trimmed to these eight entries.

Each `expected/variant/<file>.json` contains:

- the authoritative upstream `variant_text` and the raw
  `variant_bin_hex`/SHA-256;
- pyarrow-derived physical schema/values for the `id` and `var` struct columns
  (metadata/value/typed_value), with canonical checksums and samples;
- an `engine_support` block (see below).

## ALP fixture

`alp/alp_extended.zstd.parquet` (218,992 B, 9032 rows, 5 row groups, parquet-cpp-arrow
23.0.0-SNAPSHOT) has eight FLOAT/DOUBLE columns. `float_plain`/`double_plain`
use PLAIN+ZSTD; the six `*_alp_1024/4096/32` columns use ALP (encoding 10). The
upstream fixture intentionally stores the same values in the PLAIN reference
columns so an ALP decoder can be checked bit-for-bit, including three distinct
NaN payloads, signed zero, subnormals and nulls.

`expected/alp_extended.zstd.parquet.json` holds pyarrow-derived canonical
values/checksums for the two PLAIN reference columns plus metadata for all eight
columns. Those reference values are the expected output target for the six ALP
columns (row-by-row, bit-exact).

## Decoder support at collection time

| Asset | pyarrow 26.0.0 | DuckDB 1.5.6 | Polars 2.0.0 | dart_parquet 0.2.0-dev |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Variant unshredded (`case-047`…`050`) | reads as physical struct; no Variant semantics | fails: `Unsupported Arrow type VARIANT` | fails: `LogicalType union has no variant set` | `VariantColumn`; decodes NULL/true/false/34 matching upstream `cases.json` |
| Variant shredded (`case-005`/`006`/`044`/`130`) | reads as physical struct; no Variant semantics | fails: `Unsupported Arrow type VARIANT` | fails: `LogicalType union has no variant set` | `ParquetUnsupportedException: shredded VARIANT var is not supported in v0.2.0` (reconstruction pending) |
| ALP whole file | fails: `Unknown encoding type.` | fails: `TProtocolException: Invalid data` | panics: `OutOfSpec("Thrift out of range")` | reads the whole file; all six ALP columns are bit-identical to the PLAIN references, including NaN payloads and nulls |
| ALP PLAIN reference columns | readable via `columns=['float_plain','double_plain']` | not checked (whole file fails) | not checked (whole file fails) | readable |

Consequences for tests:

- Variant semantic expectations must come from upstream `cases.json`/the
  `.variant.bin` payloads, not from pyarrow. The committed physical expectations
  are still useful for schema/physical-layer regression tests.
- ALP must be tested against the in-file PLAIN references (Dart can already do
  this); pyarrow/DuckDB/Polars cannot read ALP and cannot be used as oracles.
- No engine in the table currently decodes Variant semantics, so cross-engine
  Variant verification is not possible yet.

## Deep nesting

The generic Dremel reader is also a v0.2.0 target. The existing fixtures were
already in `official/`; the manifest now records each one with SHA-256, size,
the current error and the v0.2 target:

| Fixture | Current reader (v0.1.3) | v0.2 target |
|---|---|---|
| `official/nested_lists.snappy.parquet` | `ParquetUnsupportedException: list of list…` | read `LIST<LIST<LIST<STRING>>>` |
| `official/nested_maps.snappy.parquet` | `ParquetUnsupportedException: MAP with non-leaf key/value…` | read nested MAP |
| `official/nullable.impala.parquet` | `ParquetUnsupportedException: list of list…` | read Impala nested schema |
| `official/nonnullable.impala.parquet` | `ParquetUnsupportedException: list of list…` | read Impala nested schema |
| `official/old_list_structure.parquet` | `ParquetUnsupportedException: nested repetition…` | read legacy two-level LIST |
